name: Chengqian Luo
education: M.S. Computer Engineering, New York University Tandon School of Engineering; GPA 3.93 / 4.00
B.E. Electrical Engineering and Automation, Shanghai University

evidence.statement: Productionized AWS-based agentic workflows with Amazon Bedrock Agents and Flows, backend-controlled tool execution and approval-gated workflows.
Built RAG and hybrid retrieval with Amazon OpenSearch; evaluated retrieval quality, schema-valid intake and tool trajectories.
Implemented automated testing, evaluation and monitoring pipelines, GitHub Actions and production observability with CloudWatch.
Worked on Qwen multimodal datasets, training and evaluation using PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers / PEFT and LoRA / QLoRA.
Performed distributed A100 multi-GPU training with Ray Train / Tune and PyTorch DDP, including DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 comparison and MLflow / MinIO.
Worked on inference latency and throughput optimization using vLLM, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT.
